factor_name: Trend persistence scaled by downside risk

calculation.description: Ranks assets by 60-day momentum enhanced by directional persistence and normalized by 60-day downside volatility. The persistence multiplier ranges around 0.5 to 1.5 before data-driven variation, rewarding consistent positive daily direction without using future observations. Cross-sectional ranking is used by downstream portfolio construction.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 2020-2031 regimes on the complete 15-asset tradable cross-asset universe. Positive aggregate performance is regime-dependent: weak/negative in 2022, 2026, and 2030, but strong in 2025, 2027-2028, and 2031 YTD. Interpret small cross-section uncertainty conservatively.
